editor_notes: Coverage map: Masters (A, C, I) place geography and carry VO; Singles (B, D, E, F, K) carry all spoken lines clean; Reaction (K) and clean_exit (H) give the end shape. One move per shot, all motivated: dolly-in for a private vow, pan to connect car-to-stall, tracking for Kasun’s impulse, locked-off for exchanges, held MCU for the phone call, dolly-out for the VO close.

Handles and timing: Speaking takes use 0.5 s handles to maximise action window (esp. L13 4.5 s, L16 5.9 s). The phone call and final VO each exceed a single 6 s take; they’re split: pre-ring (b14–b15) and call (b16–b17); b21 reaction then final VO master for b22. Editors can overlap these if needed; neighbours may share one block by design.

Rain continuity: Keep rainfall intensity, direction, droplet size, and awning drips consistent. Preserve puddle size and reflections across Setups A/C/E/F/H/I/K. Keep wardrobe wetness continuity (hair and cloth) between adjacent moments.
Never show the caller: The phone voice is audio only. Picture text never names the caller; listeners are written as ‘listens to the call’.

Phone and screens: We avoid readable screen text. If emphasis is needed, favour the INSERT we dropped in planning by punching into the MCU on her face or the phone hand; do not attempt to show on-screen words.

Post-only options (shoot clean sources): Allowed in edit if needed: subtle digital punch-ins on singles (B/E/F/K), gentle speed ramps on the dolly moves (B, I) to polish timing, and a brief hold (freeze) on the last frame of I if VO needs tail. No split diopter, no mirrors, no fast UI reads. Keep the rain sound bed clean for possible VO/music.

Match/risk notes: The pan in C bridges car-to-stall; cut to D tracking on Kasun over a small axis—use the moment he lifts the phone as the action match. The shared eyeline (E to F and back) is maintained screen-left/right; avoid flipping. The call pair (E: c13 then c08) are same setup and lens for seamless cut-in to the longer call hold.

Sound beds: Heavy rain + traffic is the spine. Effects to catch: umbrella rustle, puddle footfalls, car door, phone ring, kettle hiss. Keep dialogue on booms/lavs under rain; ADR can top up later. VO lines (L22) and thought (L3) ride over picture; no lips move for those lines.
What we avoided in camera: readable screens; any crowded background action that needs faces sharp; complex multi-move shots. One move per clip throughout.
